identitySignals: Name matches registered 501(c)(3) 'Bay Area Community Resources', El Cerrito, CA, EIN 94-2346815 (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer); El Cerrito is one of the two cities named in the agenda text

Organization's own website (bacr.org) lists its address at 11175 San Pablo Ave, El Cerrito, CA and describes expanded learning (afterschool) programs, matching OUSD's after-school and student-support contracts and the 21st Century grant funding
An OUSD school page (Westlake Middle School) states it partners with Bay Area Community Resources (BACR) to run its Expanded Learning Program
research.notes: The website lists no public phone number or general email, so those are null. The address appears on the site with a pipe separator ('11175 San Pablo Ave | El Cerrito, CA 94530'). The agenda also lists San Rafael, CA, which is where older directory listings place the organization (171 Carlos Drive); the organization's current site and ProPublica show El Cerrito. California entity number and SAM UEI not looked up.

profile.address: 11175 San Pablo Ave, El Cerrito, CA 94530
profile.summary: Bay Area Community Resources (BACR) is a nonprofit that provides services to schools and communities across the San Francisco Bay Area. Its programs include afterschool and expanded learning, behavioral and mental health services, healthy schools and communities, national service (AmeriCorps), and youth workforce and reentry.
